To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Web services security vulnerabilities are similar to the ones in the grid, and that the security of Web services is a prerequisite to the security of grid services.
the security vulnerabilities and threats in Web services and grid are the same, and that the security model for grid and Web services security should include the same security services.

the Web services security vulnerabilities and threats can be analyzed and classified in a similar way as in case of grid computing and that the proposed security model can be applied for the design and implementation of a security architecture in service oriented environments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the security aspects of grid services, which are based on the Web services standards.
developing a comprehensive and systematic approach to security analysis, design and deployment in grid environments.

the following issues: - Security vulnerabilities in grid and Web services - Security threats in grid and Web service environments - Security models for grid and Web service interactions - Security services for grid and Web services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the security of grid and Web services should be considered as a whole.
Web services security and grid security are two different things, which can be combined into a single framework, but not necessarily.
Web services and grid security is still an open issue.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been working on the security model for Web services and grid, and have been developing the model for the EGEE project.

there are a lot of security threats that need to be addressed, however, the security model and the classification provide a basis for developing a set of recommendations for secure grid and Web services.
the proposed model can be used for developing security solutions that are more resilient to attacks, and can be more effectively tested.
The main takeaway from our work is that
security vulnerabilities in grid and Web services are very similar and can be addressed by similar security mechanisms.
the grid security is a complex issue that requires a holistic view of the problem and an integrated approach to security services design and deployment.

a layered security model is needed to protect grid and Web services against attacks and vulnerabilities, and that the security services should be integrated in a service oriented architecture to provide a seamless and transparent protection to the user.
